name: DNZ Citation Readiness Checker
author: dnztechnologies

sections.description:
Search is changing. AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI answer engines now summarize and cite sources directly on the results page — and research shows that many of the pages they cite don’t even rank in the traditional top 10 organic results.

DNZ Citation Readiness Checker adds a simple checklist to the WordPress block editor sidebar, so you can see — while you’re writing, not after you publish — whether a post is structured in a way that AI systems are more likely to cite.

What it checks

  • Direct-answer opening — does your post open with a clear, direct sentence, or does the answer get buried under an intro?
  • Question-style headings — are any of your H2/H3 headings phrased as real questions, matching how people ask AI tools?
  • Meta summary / excerpt — is a clear excerpt set, giving search and AI systems a clean description to draw from?
  • Content depth — is there enough substance (roughly 300+ words) to be worth citing as a source?
  • Freshness — has the post been updated recently? Research shows recently-updated content is cited significantly more often than stale content.
  • Structured format — does the post use lists or tables where it makes sense? Structured formats are cited more often than plain prose.

Each check gives a plain-English pass/warn/missing status and a specific suggestion — no jargon, no vague scores.

What this plugin does not do

To be transparent about scope: this plugin only checks on-page content factors that are visible from inside the post editor. It does not check or affect off-page factors like backlinks, domain authority, page speed, or third-party review platform presence — all of which also influence AI citation likelihood, but are outside what a content editor tool can evaluate. Think of this as one part of a broader AI-visibility strategy, not the whole picture.

Privacy

This plugin runs entirely inside your WordPress admin editor. It does not send any data to external servers, does not call any third-party API, and does not track or collect any information about you or your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dnz-citation-readiness-checker directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page in the block editor.
  4. Click the three-dot menu in the top right and select “DNZ Citation Readiness,” or find its icon among the editor’s sidebar icons.
  5. The checklist updates live as you write.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin change anything on my live site?

No. It only runs inside the WordPress post editor (admin area) and never affects your site’s front end or what visitors see.

Does this guarantee my content will be cited by AI search tools?

No tool can guarantee that — AI citation depends on many factors, including some (like domain authority and backlinks) that are outside any single plugin’s control. This checklist addresses the on-page factors that research has linked to citation likelihood, but it is one input among several.

Will this slow down my editor?

No. All checks run instantly in your browser against the content already loaded in the editor — there are no external requests or API calls.

Does this work with Yoast SEO / Rank Math / All in One SEO?

Yes. This plugin adds its own separate sidebar panel and does not modify or interfere with other SEO plugins.
